people.name: Beriah
people.line: Son of Ephraim born after family tragedy

translations.web: He went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
translations.bsb: And again he slept with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. So he named him Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house.
translations.kjv: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
translations.asv: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
